_doc: KEV entries for software the Debian security tracker does not cover (vendor repositories, tarballs). A KEV entry matches a row when vendorProject equals `vendor` (case-insensitive) and product STARTS WITH `product` (case-insensitive); an installed binary matches when its name fits one of `packages` (case-insensitive, * and ? wildcards). The result is only CHECK (installed version shown, vendor fix status not verifiable automatically), and only for KEV entries added in the last VULNWATCH_CHECK_DAYS days (default 30). A package whose Debian source has a tracker entry for the CVE is judged by the tracker, never here. Software that Debian itself ships and tracks (Apache HTTP Server, Nginx, OpenSSH, ...) needs no row.

note: Chrome components (Blink, Media, WebAudio, FreeType, ...) as shipped by the vendor repository
